segments.text: Like a dog bite, like the bee sting, I don't feel so fuckin' bad! Rain tubs on roses and whiskers on kittens, Like copper petals and warm woolen mittens, Brown paper packages tied up with strings, These are a few of my favorite things! Green-colored ponies and grist-clad bursudo, Sword bells and sleigh bells and schnitzel with noodles,

While geese do fly with the moon on the wings, these are a few of my favorite things. When the dog bites, when the bee stinks, when I'm feeling sad, I simply remember my favorite things, then I don't feel so bad.
Clothes and white dresses with blue satin sashes. Snowflakes that stay on my nose and eyelashes. Silver white winters that melt into sprues. These are a few of my favorite things.
